A 0 to 1 score representing how much a particular stock is talked about. 0 indicates that other scores would also be N/A.

A score ranging from -1 to 1 expressing optimism to future growth of stock. -1 means maximum pessimism or minimum optimism towards a stock.

A score ranging from -1 to 1 indicating bubble risk on a stock, considering speculative bubbles using social media and emotional expectations.
A score scaled between -1 to 1 expressing net sentiment on stock.

Net emotional sentiment on the stock, ranging from -1 (more negative emotion) to +1 (more positive emotion)

Forecasts of buying net of forecasts of shorting/selling scaled from -1 to 1
